$schema: T-335 detection-checks manifest — read by the round-8 review contract to classify a fresh finding as SHOULD-HAVE-BEEN-CAUGHT (a listed check already covers this finding's class) vs a genuinely new gap.

checks.findingClass: live IPO publishes an open/close date, price band, lot size, or issue size that disagrees with an independent non-ingested oracle
checks.githubIssue: https://github.com/abhayla/IPODhan/issues/199 (G-N, T-472, 2026-09-07): extended from 2 fields (dates only, Chittorgarh oracle) to 6 fields against ipowatch.in, a source the scraper does NOT ingest -- Chittorgarh is ingested (scraper/src/scrapers/chittorgarh-scraper.ts), so comparing against it proved nothing about a scraper defect. The 4 P1s originally cited (subscription understated, band collapsed, Fascinate Textiles priced low) were invisible to a dates-only compare.
checks.failThreshold: any OPEN/UPCOMING IPO whose published openDate, closeDate, priceRangeMin, priceRangeMax, or issueSize disagrees with the value this audit fetches LIVE from ipowatch.in (PRIMARY signal, owned by nothing in our pipeline) - dates compared exactly, priceRangeMin/priceRangeMax/issueSize tolerate a 1% relative difference (ipowatch rounds, e.g. 'Approx Rs 40.88 Crores'). lotSize is ALSO folded into this check's violations, but (T-506, #415, 2026-09-08) no longer compared directly against ipowatch's figure: ipowatch's 'minimum bid is N Shares' line is the MINIMUM RETAIL APPLICATION, not the exchange lot -- since SEBI's 2025 SME rule change that figure is 2x the exchange lot for SME issues (Qualiance International: lot_size=1000, ipowatch=2000, both correct). The lot comparison divides ipowatch's figure by the segment's minimum-application-lot multiplier (SME=2, MAINBOARD=1, findLotDisagreements() in scripts/lib/detection-floor-checks.mjs) before comparing to our exchange lot. See the sibling check a_b_min_application for the direct minimum-retail-application comparison. An unresolved data_conflicts row on a HIGH_VALUE field is a SECONDARY signal. The primary comparison is deliberately independent because the cross-source monitor resolves and re-inserts every row each 30-minute cycle (T-335C), and field_sources.previous_source is populated on 1 of 5746 prod rows so it cannot serve as the oracle.
checks.unverifiableWhen: the ipowatch list-index fetch fails or returns no rows (the check is BLIND, and pages P2); a matched company whose detail page cannot be parsed is excluded from comparison, not silently passed

checks.findingClass: live IPO's derived minimum retail application (exchange lot x segment multiplier) disagrees with the independent non-ingested oracle's minimum-bid-shares figure
checks.githubIssue: https://github.com/abhayla/IPODhan/issues/415 (T-506, 2026-09-08, owner decision 4): the nightly a_b_live_conflict FAILed on Qualiance International (SME, OPEN) because ipowatch.in's 'minimum bid is 2000 Shares' line was compared directly against ipos.lot_size=1000. Both figures were correct -- 1000 is the exchange lot, 2000 is the SME retail minimum RETAIL APPLICATION (2 lots, SEBI ICDR rule since 2025). Split out as its own check so the two concepts each get a distinct, correctly-derived comparison and a distinct PASS/FAIL, instead of one check silently comparing the wrong pair.
checks.failThreshold: any OPEN/UPCOMING IPO where our derived minimum retail application (ipos.lot_size x minApplicationLots(segment), where the multiplier is 2 for SME and 1 for MAINBOARD/unknown -- see scripts/lib/detection-floor-checks.mjs minApplicationLots()) disagrees with the minimum-bid-shares figure this audit fetches LIVE from ipowatch.in, via findMinApplicationDisagreements(). Compared exactly (no rupee tolerance -- share counts, not rupee amounts). Shares the same ipowatch fetch as a_b_live_conflict (checkA_B() in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs) -- no second HTTP round.
checks.unverifiableWhen: the ipowatch list-index fetch fails or returns no rows (the check is BLIND, and pages P2, in lockstep with a_b_live_conflict since they share the same fetch); a matched company whose detail page cannot be parsed is excluded from comparison, not silently passed

checks.findingClass: issue_size (total incl. OFS) falls outside a one-sided plausibility band against shares_offered x price_range_max
checks.failThreshold: issue_size < 0.75x OR issue_size > 3.0x of shares_offered x price_range_max, when both are present (T-452, 2026-09-07: redefined from a symmetric +/-25% band)
checks.unverifiableWhen: shares_offered not yet scraped for the row (skipped, not a violation)
checks.note: T-452 owner decision 2026-09-07: ipos.issue_size is the TOTAL issue size INCLUDING OFS (schema.ts documents fresh_issue + ofs_issue summing to issue_size); subscriptions.shares_offered is the NET public offer (anchor/market-maker excluded). Under this definition, issue_size / (shares_offered x price_range_max) legitimately runs 1.0-1.9x on real rows (Meesho 1.76x, Wakefit 1.82x, Aequs 1.77x) - the prior symmetric +/-25% band false-positived every one of them. The band is now one-sided: below 0.75x still flags a share-count/wrong-unit-down value; above 3.0x flags a wrong-unit-up value. This closed the design item the prior note left open.

checks.findingClass: issue_size holds a magnitude implausible for its segment (share count stored as rupees)
checks.failThreshold: issue_size > 0 AND issue_size < Rs10,00,00,000 for MAINBOARD, or < Rs1,00,00,000 for SME
checks.unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos table

checks.findingClass: a row typed offering_type=IPO matches the shape of a corporate action (demerger/scheme-of-arrangement)
checks.failThreshold: offering_type=IPO AND price_range_min==price_range_max AND lot_size==100 AND close_date-open_date in [10..14] days
checks.unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos table

checks.findingClass: lot_size x price_range_max implies a retail application size SEBI would not permit
checks.failThreshold: lot value outside [Rs8,000..Rs20,000] MAINBOARD or [Rs90,000..Rs3,00,000] SME, for offering_type=IPO
checks.unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos table

checks.findingClass: a public API route 5xxs, or leaks SQL/stack-trace text in its response body
checks.failThreshold: any enumerated web/app/api/** non-admin route returns >=500, or its body matches a SQL/bound-param/stack-trace pattern
checks.unverifiableWhen: any enumerated public route is unreachable (the sweep did not cover its whole population)

checks.findingClass: /api/ipos/<slug> (or the /ipos/<slug> page, same resolution path) resolves an unknown slug to a DIFFERENT IPO instead of 404ing
checks.failThreshold: any of 3 nonsense slugs (never a real row) does not return 404, OR a real currently-live slug does not resolve to itself
checks.unverifiableWhen: a request is unreachable (timeout/network), or there is no LISTED row to run the positive case against
checks.note: T-485 (2026-09-07): findBySlugWithFallback used to accept any best-scoring Fuse.js fuzzy match with no floor, so 'karamtara-engineering-ltd' (no row on prod) resolved to 'Sumax Engineering Ltd.' purely on the shared word 'engineering' (measured score 0.44, 56% similarity). Fixed by resolving only via the slug-redirect table, an exact normalized company-name match, or a fuzzy match at or above an 85% similarity floor (measured: a genuine one-typo pair scores 15%, comfortably inside; the karamtara/sumax collision at 44% is rejected by more than double the margin) — everything else 404s, with the miss negative-cached per #344.

checks.findingClass: the data_conflicts table is dominated by non-actionable noise, burying genuine P1 disagreements
checks.failThreshold: (empty value2 OR value1==value2) / total unresolved >= 5% OR total unresolved > 500 (#191 F2, unbounded-growth ceiling, T-285 11,493-row incident)
checks.unverifiableWhen: data_conflicts table not present

checks.findingClass: an offering_type's calendar has gone stale with no per-type freshness check to catch it
checks.failThreshold: newest row age exceeds 3 days (IPO/SME) or 21 days (OFS/NCD/RIGHTS)
checks.unverifiableWhen: no rows exist yet for that offering_type

checks.findingClass: the conflict detector reports zero new conflicts while an independent invariant (checkPriceBand) is demonstrably violated on live IPO rows — the detector is inert, not the data clean
checks.failThreshold: checkPriceBand violations on offering_type=IPO rows > 0 AND data_conflicts rows inserted (detected_at) in the last 24h == 0
checks.unverifiableWhen: data_conflicts or ipos table not present
checks.note: #191 F3 (T-297 D6), the important one — a detector reporting zero looks like health unless cross-checked against an invariant independently known to be violated: conflictsDetected read 0 every cycle across 3,760 fields consolidated from 6 sources while T-272 P1-1 simultaneously proved real disagreements existed.

checks.findingClass: a scraper_logs FAILURE/PARTIAL message repeats so often it stops functioning as a signal while the underlying rows still write through
checks.failThreshold: any single (truncated) error_message occurs more than 20 times in scraper_logs (status FAILURE/PARTIAL) in the last 24h
checks.unverifiableWhen: scraper_logs table not present
checks.note: #191 F1 (T-297 D6): the InvIT/REIT unit-price WARN was logged 20+ times per cycle every cycle (T-272 P2-2) while the mis-typed rows were written anyway and rendered as ₹0.00.

checks.findingClass: an IPO the external market lists (chittorgarh.com's public dashboard) has no matching row on our site, or has one mistyped as offering_type != 'IPO' (the Mopshop shape), or its detail page 404s / renders a different company (the T-460 e_unknown_slug_404 shape) -- every OTHER check iterates OUR OWN rows and cannot find a row we never created
checks.sourceTask: #187 (T-461), filed by T-297 discovery-coverage meta-analysis (D2 reverse sweep); real-world instance issue #351 (prod missing Karamtara Engineering/Infrax Renewable/Rentomojo/Manipal Payment/Steamhouse India/Vinod Texworld while staging had discovered several days earlier)
checks.failThreshold: any chittorgarh.com dashboard IPO (mainboard + SME, OPEN/UPCOMING) fails any of: (a) a matching row exists on the target (slug, then normalized-name search, both compared with the trailing legal-entity suffix stripped), (b) that row's offeringType == 'IPO', (c) GET {BASE_URL}/ipos/<slug> returns 200 and the body mentions the company name
checks.unverifiableWhen: the external calendar (both chittorgarh dashboard fetches) could not be reached at all -- BLIND, not a pass. NOTE: does not cover recently-CLOSED (30-day) IPOs -- chittorgarh's listing-date report renders client-side and ipowatch.in was unreachable from the environment this check was authored in; see scripts/lib/chittorgarh-oracle-parser.mjs 'KNOWN GAP'.

checks.findingClass: an API and its backing table each look correct in isolation while a stale cache key or wrong filter silently serves a different row count than the DB holds (T-272 P1-2: /api/registrars served 41 rows while the DB held 15 -- 26 unit-test fixture rows stranded in a 7-day Redis key after an integration suite was pointed at production)
checks.sourceTask: #186 (T-460), filed by T-297 discovery-coverage meta-analysis (D5 serving-vs-storage delta)
checks.failThreshold: for any of /api/registrars, /api/ipos?status=OPEN&limit=100, /api/ipos?status=UPCOMING&limit=100, /api/market-holidays?year=<current>: served row count (live HTTP JSON body) != stored row count (matching filtered DB query) -- exact equality, not a tolerance
checks.unverifiableWhen: the live HTTP fetch or the matching DB query fails (marked unverifiable, not a false PASS)

checks.findingClass: a pm2 process runs without TZ in its environment, exposing new Date() parsing to the box's local time
checks.failThreshold: any pm2 process's env lacks a TZ key
checks.unverifiableWhen: pm2 not reachable on the host running the audit (expected off the production box)

checks.findingClass: an unrotated pm2 log file is growing unbounded, risking the 2026-06-13 disk-full class
checks.failThreshold: any pm2 out/err log file exceeds 100 MB
checks.unverifiableWhen: pm2 not reachable on the host running the audit

checks.findingClass: a scheduler/cron/job definition exists in the repo but is never imported by the prod entrypoint
checks.failThreshold: any scraper/src/scheduler/*.ts file not `import`-ed by scraper/src/index.ts, ecosystem.config.js, or scripts/deploy-linux.sh
checks.unverifiableWhen: never — static analysis of the checked-out repo

checks.findingClass: a cron-invoked script is committed without the executable bit, so a direct cron invocation fails silently
checks.failThreshold: git-tracked mode of a cron entrypoint script lacks any execute bit
checks.unverifiableWhen: git ls-files fails (corrupt checkout)

checks.findingClass: a scraper source has been degraded/dead for many cycles with no owner decision to fix or retire it
checks.failThreshold: a source has >=7 consecutive non-SUCCESS-or-zero-record cycles and is not listed in docs/reviews/dead-source-retirement.json
checks.unverifiableWhen: scraper_logs table not present

checks.findingClass: the sector field/facet is populated for too few real IPOs to be usable
checks.failThreshold: populated sector fraction < 50% of real IPOs
checks.unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos table

checks.findingClass: an offering_type=IPO row has a NULL segment
checks.failThreshold: any offering_type=IPO row with segment IS NULL — an empty/whitespace segment counts as blank, not only SQL NULL.
checks.unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos table

checks.findingClass: a post-scrape step fails every cycle, hidden by its non-fatal catch, while the cycle keeps exiting 0
checks.failThreshold: any step in the derived STEP_NAMES whose most recent scraper_steps rows show status=failed for >= 3 consecutive cycles (leading streak, newest-first). 2 is a blip and PASSes; a non-failed row ends the streak.
checks.unverifiableWhen: same as k_step_ledger_silence — unparseable STEP_NAMES, missing scraper_steps table, or an empty 24h window

checks.findingClass: a post-scrape step is wired and runs every cycle but produces no successful work — skipped for an unread reason, or failing inside its non-fatal catch
checks.failThreshold: any step in the exported STEP_NAMES of scraper/src/index.ts with ZERO rows of status=ok in scraper_steps over the last 24h. The expected-step list is DERIVED from that constant at audit time (parseStepNames), never hand-typed here — a hand-typed copy is the i_wire_or_retire class itself. skipped rows do not count as ok: a step skipped every cycle (ADMIN_API_TOKEN unset) is still a step doing nothing.
checks.unverifiableWhen: STEP_NAMES cannot be parsed from scraper/src/index.ts, the scraper_steps table is absent (migration 0033 not applied), or the table has zero rows in the window (the ledger writer has not run). Zero rows is deliberately UNVERIFIABLE rather than 12 simultaneous FAILs — a genuinely dead scraper is caught independently by g_freshness_per_type.

checks.findingClass: our published OPEN/UPCOMING set disagrees with the exchange that actually runs the issue
round7Findings: T-340 (new coverage — no round-7 finding; our live status set had NO independent oracle at all)
checks.failThreshold: any MAINBOARD row naming NSE among its listing exchanges where (a) we publish OPEN but NSE current-issue does not list it, (b) NSE current-issue lists it as open while we publish UPCOMING or no OPEN row, or (c) an NSE current/upcoming issue has no OPEN/UPCOMING row of ours at all. Scope excludes SME (NSE Emerge is not on these endpoints), BSE-only rows, and rows with unknown listing exchanges — FAILing those would be noise, and a muted channel is a dead mechanism.
checks.unverifiableWhen: the NSE cookie handshake or either feed fetch fails, or both feeds return zero usable rows (indistinguishable from a broken feed, so never read as "nothing is open today"). UNVERIFIABLE pages and exits 3 — never a silent PASS (T-321 class).

checks.findingClass: a LISTED IPO inside the 10-day window is stuck at the front of the document rotation, either with document rows and zero fetch-state rows (shape 1), or with fetch-state rows that exist but are stale (shape 2)
checks.sourceTask: rotation-stall-null-fetch-state (2026-09-06); stale-max-last-attempt shape added 2026-09-06 round 2 (W-136, runDocumentCycle budget-trip LISTED reservation)
checks.failThreshold: shape 1: no LISTED IPO inside the LISTED_ROTATION_WINDOW_DAYS-day live window has documents on file but 0 document_fetch_state rows - MAX(last_attempt_at) sorts a 0-row IPO first forever (NULLS FIRST), so it occupies the front of the LISTED rotation queue every cycle and starves every LISTED row behind it. shape 2: no LISTED IPO inside the live window has >=1 DUE document_fetch_state row (state not in FOUND/NOT_APPLICABLE/SUPERSEDED, AND next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= now() - a row in a deliberate future backoff is NOT due and must not count) whose MAX(last_attempt_at) across all its rows is more than STALE_ROTATION_HOURS (24h) old, or null - a full live (OPEN/CLOSED/UPCOMING) backlog can trip the discovery budget before the LISTED tier every cycle, so rows exist but `last_attempt_at` never advances even though the cycle runs every 30 minutes
checks.unverifiableWhen: document_fetch_state or documents table not present

checks.findingClass: a row settles NOT_YET_FILED - 'the company has not filed it', no retry, no alert - on a rung chain in which not one source ANSWERED. T-403 Class 1, found in four consecutive rounds through four different doors (SEBI failures returning null; a 503 written as not-filed; escalation-budget refusals returning 'absent'; an unsettled EXCHANGES:no_link inherited through an escalation whose every rung was skipped). Each code fix closed the door it could see; this check watches the room
checks.failThreshold: state = NOT_YET_FILED AND doc_type is one the exchanges cannot serve (DRHP) AND the row's own last_attempt chain for that type has zero answered rungs (every non-EXCHANGES rung is skipped: or failed:). A row with no chain recorded is skipped, never guessed at
checks.unverifiableWhen: document_fetch_state table not present

checks.findingClass: a filing has been unreachable on every source for a day or more and nobody noticed, because the P2 alert fires once on entry and then scrolls away
checks.failThreshold: any document_fetch_state row in BLOCKED_ALL with blocked_since_at older than 24h (aged from blocked_since_at, NOT last_attempt_at: a row retried every 30 min has a fresh last-attempt forever)
checks.unverifiableWhen: document_fetch_state table not present

checks.findingClass: the BSE payload lists more lead managers than we stored (the co-BRLM parser drops entries after the first "#"-separated one)
checks.failThreshold: array_length(lead_managers) < ipos.bse_payload_lead_manager_count for any IPO. Storing MORE is not flagged: other sources legitimately add managers BSE omits
checks.unverifiableWhen: no IPO has a recorded bse_payload_lead_manager_count yet

checks.findingClass: the document cycle (scraper/src/services/document-cycle.ts, primarySourceDiscovery step) runs longer than its wake budget, or two wakes' cycles overlap — the class fixed one write path in August (w177-detection-rca.md) and recurred on this path in September because no independent check re-verified cycle duration
round7Findings: cycle-overrun RCA (2026-09-06, observed 1,210-1,278s document cycles / 105-115 network calls per cycle on a Sunday)
checks.failThreshold: any primarySourceDiscovery row in scraper_steps (created_at, duration_ms) over the last 24h with duration_ms > 25 minutes, OR two rows for different cycleIds whose [start, end) wall-clock windows overlap (checkCycleOverrun in scripts/lib/document-state-checks.mjs, unit-tested in scripts/tests/document-state-checks.test.mjs).
checks.unverifiableWhen: the scraper_steps table is absent (migration 0033 not applied), or it has zero primarySourceDiscovery rows in the last 24h (ENABLE_DOCUMENT_STATE_MACHINE off, or the writer has not run yet).

checks.findingClass: the deploy-failure STATUS row (scripts/deploy-status.mjs) is write-only - written on failure, cleared on the next success, but never read back - so a row can sit open on disk indefinitely with nothing surfacing it
checks.failThreshold: any slot's deploy-failure STATUS row (deploy-failure-status.json) has been open for more than 24h
checks.warnThreshold: a slot's row is open but under 24h old - a normal in-progress-fix window, not yet an outage
checks.unverifiableWhen: the deploy-failure-status.json file exists but could not be read/parsed (an ABSENT file is a legitimate PASS - no deploy has ever failed)

checks.findingClass: the document_fetch_state table is absent, so the whole document pipeline is invisible to the audit tonight
checks.failThreshold: never FAILs — reports UNVERIFIABLE, because "the audit could not see" is not "documents are healthy"
checks.unverifiableWhen: document_fetch_state table not present (migration 0035 not applied)

checks.findingClass: a stored documents.type disagrees with what the classifier says the URL/title is — the classifier fix was forward-only, so rows stored under the old wrong type stayed wrong and invisible
checks.failThreshold: any documents row whose stored type has a permitted REFINEMENT to what the classifier returns (RHP->PROSPECTUS, ADDENDUM->CORRIGENDUM/PRICE_BAND_AD, BASIS_OF_ALLOTMENT->BASIS_OF_ALLOTMENT_AD). An UNRELATED reclassification is not a nightly FAIL — that is a source/classifier change for a human, surfaced by scraper/src/scripts/retype-misclassified-documents.ts
checks.unverifiableWhen: documents table not present

checks.findingClass: a document repeatedly fails extraction, which is a parse bug needing a human rather than a data outage
checks.failThreshold: WARN-level only: any row in EXTRACT_FAILED
checks.unverifiableWhen: document_fetch_state table not present

checks.findingClass: a required document type (DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS) on a live-window IPO is stuck in extraction (MANUAL_REVIEW, EXTRACT_FAILED, FAILED behind a HARD_FAILURE marker, or FAILED repeatedly WITHOUT ever escalating to a HARD_FAILURE marker or MANUAL_REVIEW) with nothing FAIL-level watching it
checks.sourceTask: round-5 review-of-the-reviews (#333 follow-up); 4th shape added T-494 (#396, spawnSync ETIMEDOUT never escalating)
checks.failThreshold: any UPCOMING/OPEN/CLOSED/LISTED IPO's DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS document has extraction_status=MANUAL_REVIEW, a sibling document_fetch_state.state=EXTRACT_FAILED, extraction_status=FAILED with an extraction_error starting HARD_FAILURE:, OR extraction_status=FAILED with retry_count between 3 and MAX_EXTRACTION_ATTEMPTS(10) exclusive and NO HARD_FAILURE: marker, for more than 48h
checks.unverifiableWhen: never - always runs against documents/document_fetch_state joined to ipos

checks.findingClass: a merged PR labelled fixes-live-bug is not yet being served in production — the bug it fixed is still live
checks.failThreshold: for every merged PR carrying the `fixes-live-bug` label, the served SHA's commit time (read via git log against the SHA from GET {BASE_URL}/api/version — the same way the T-324 SHA-drift monitor reads it) is older than the PR's mergedAt for more than 24h
checks.warnThreshold: same comparison, but the merge is under 24h old — a normal deploy-lag window, not yet an outage
checks.unverifiableWhen: gh could not list merged fixes-live-bug PRs, OR the served SHA could not be read (unreachable / returned "unknown"), OR the served SHA has no locally-known commit time

checks.findingClass: a document was downloaded and then never read, so the fields it carries stay empty while the pipeline looks healthy
checks.failThreshold: any row FOUND for more than 48h once the extractor is wired; deliberately INERT while ENABLE_DRHP_EXTRACTION is off, since FOUND is terminal by design until WP C
checks.unverifiableWhen: document_fetch_state table not present

checks.findingClass: the document job silently stopped: a live IPO has no state rows at all, so nothing was even attempted for it
checks.failThreshold: any UPCOMING/OPEN/CLOSED IPO with zero document_fetch_state rows. This is the only check that notices the machine wrote NOTHING — every other check reads rows it wrote
checks.unverifiableWhen: document_fetch_state table not present

checks.findingClass: a document the pipeline can never reach settles as NOT_YET_FILED and stays there silently forever — NOT_YET_FILED is deliberately not a failure, which is exactly what makes an unreachable document invisible (T-403 B-1: the SEBI rung could never fire for a DRHP)
checks.failThreshold: NOT_YET_FILED past its filing calendar: DRHP >14d from first sight, RHP >2d after open, PROSPECTUS >3d after close (listing is T+3 and a company cannot list before the Prospectus is filed), anchor report >1d after open. A row whose governing date is missing is skipped, never guessed at
checks.unverifiableWhen: document_fetch_state table not present

checks.findingClass: the offer-document path stalls and the site falls back to republishing websites' transcriptions of the filing — the document's share of RECENT provenance writes on printed offer-term fields collapses
checks.failThreshold: document-sourced (source='DRHP') rows are under 5% of all non-ADMIN field_sources rows WRITTEN IN THE LAST 14 DAYS across issueSize, faceValue, priceRangeMin/Max, lotSize, min_investment, issue_price, fresh_issue_size, offer_for_sale_size, registrar, leadManagers, companyName (healthy today, measured on staging 2026-09-08 over the 14-day window: 10.2% — 39 document-sourced vs 342 website-sourced)
checks.unverifiableWhen: field_sources is unreadable, or fewer than 20 provenance rows were written on the printed offer-term fields in the 14-day window

notCoveredByThisManifest: c1_hard_date_trust_on_update (#180 F2, T-459) — a single non-authoritative source asserting open_date/close_date on UPDATE onto a previously-null field with zero field_sources corroboration is not a separately-recorded check: guarded at rest by the existing g_provenance_lineage C1 lineage-ceiling gate (scripts/audit-ipo-coverage.mjs:501 — a hard date with zero field_sources lineage is the same signature) and at write-time by scraper/tests/unit/services/data-persister-180-sme-fpo-hard-date.test.ts.
P2-9 / P3-4 (empty content tables, fieldCompleteness thresholds) — owned by T-331's threshold work on audit-ipo-coverage.mjs, not duplicated here
P3-3 (always-red Production Verification GitHub Actions workflow) — owned by T-326
P2-7 ecosystem.config.js dead-config class beyond TZ — owned by T-327's assert-env-keys.sh work; this manifest's h_pm2_env_tz check is the audit-side companion

g_provenance_lineage (#188 C1: hard date/band asserted with zero field_sources lineage rows) — owned by scripts/audit-ipo-coverage.mjs --gate (declining-ceiling WARNING against a committed baseline, config/provenance-lineage-baseline.json, not a hard 0-gate, until the T-292 legacy-row drain completes)

g_duplicate_identity (#188 C2: two different genuine IPOs holding byte-identical date/band/lot/issue_size) — owned by scripts/audit-ipo-coverage.mjs --gate (HARD, MUST be 0, except entries on config/duplicate-identity-allowlist.json which WARN)

g_deployed_sha_lineage (T-297 discovery-coverage sweep, #194) — the sha deploy-linux.sh is about to flip to must be an ancestor of origin/main (T-264 P2-4: prod once served a commit that existed only on an unmerged branch while missing main's merged fix). This is a deploy-time gate (assert_deployed_sha_lineage() in scripts/deploy-linux.sh, run right after $SHA is resolved and again, idempotently, right before the flip), not a nightly DB-row audit — it cannot be a checks[] entry here since this manifest's own wire-or-retire test (audit-detection-floor.test.mjs) requires every declared id to be record()-ed by audit-detection-floor.mjs, and this check never runs inside that script. ALLOW_UNMERGED_DEPLOY=1 is the deliberate escape hatch for a genuine pre-merge hotfix; it fires a Notifier P2 naming the sha+branch. Guarded instead by scripts/tests/deploy-linux.test.sh case 32 (a-e) (see docs/reviews/failure-classes.md, 'deployed sha not on origin/main').

g_test_coverage_negative_grep (T-470, issue #197) — CI-time (pr-gate.yml, every PR) negative grep for untested web data components / scraper validation rules / priority-matrix field keys, enforced by web/tests/unit/meta/coverage-negative-grep.test.ts + scraper/tests/unit/meta/coverage-negative-grep.test.ts against config/coverage-negative-grep-baseline.json (shrink-only ratchet) and config/coverage-negative-grep-allowlist.json (reasoned permanent exemptions). exitCodes.1: at least one check FAILed — a defect is live
exitCodes.2: the audit itself crashed or could not start
exitCodes.3: no FAIL, but at least one check is UNVERIFIABLE — the audit was blind tonight, not green (FAIL dominates when both occur)

paging.model: one DIGEST page per check per night (title, failing-row count, first 10 rows, pointer to the full report on the box) — never one page per row
paging.severityRule: P1 when the check has rows that were NOT present in the previous run (state persisted in the audit state dir); P2 for an unchanged backlog
paging.dedupeKey: detection-floor-<checkId>-<YYYY-MM-DD> for FAIL digests; detection-floor-unverifiable-<checkId>-<YYYY-MM-DD> for UNVERIFIABLE pages — date-scoped so the Notifier 30-minute cooldown cannot swallow the nightly digest
paging.unverifiablePages: every UNVERIFIABLE check pages P2; an UNVERIFIABLE check is never treated as a pass
